title: CFCO intersyndical strike pre-notice in Pointe-Noire
reason: Outside the assigned month and only a pre-notice is described; no executed public gathering is established.
notes: Adiac says the notice was issued 30 September. Keep distinct from any later strike or demonstration.

title: UMNG indefinite staff strike and academic suspension
reason: The accessed article documents a work stoppage and suspended academic activities, not a public protest gathering; no crowd size is given.
notes: Onset conflict: Adiac says 1 October; a December ACI retrospective says 27 September (cross-unit source COB12S001). No conclusion on ownership. This exclusion is about available evidence of a strike only, not a finding that no public gathering occurred.

title: STPU work stoppage beginning 7 October
reason: The reported strike and service disruption alone do not establish a public gathering on the onset date.
notes: The separately reported 18 October demonstration is retained as event candidate COB2024-10-E001; do not infer one gathering per city from service impacts.

title: Dolisie municipal indefinite strike and planned city closure
reason: The source is a 12 October advance announcement of a strike planned for 14 October; this search did not verify execution.
notes: No zero-event inference: retain follow-up as a gap and keep the actual 10 October staff assembly as separate pending candidate.

title: CHU-B general strike with minimum service
reason: The sources document a workplace strike and minimum service; no public gathering or participant count is reported.
notes: ACI body was not returned in full; the newspaper issue reports the strike. No assertion that a separate public action did not occur.

title: Pointe-Noire municipal staff strike
reason: The issue reports municipal administration disruption for several days and an agreement ending the strike on 28 October, but no public gathering is described.
notes: Start date and number of striking/assembled workers remain unknown.
